reason: My whole business lives on Tripadvisor and Google stars, and I'm not putting a QR code on every table that invites tourists to rate each dish publicly on a platform I don't control. The free months don't help if one bad khinkali night stays on there forever.
objection: Dish-by-dish ratings that are public and permanent; one off night in the kitchen and it's on record, plus a payment fee on top of what my terminal already charges.
would_change_my_mind: If dish ratings came to me privately first, so I could fix the problem before anything goes public, and the guest payment fee was no higher than my current terminal.
